goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: holding the aperture open by force; a thousand claws gripping one small circle of refusal; the labour cannot feed on what will not break
next: testing if the thousand can move as one body without the single crab's ghost dissolving in the motion; learning to walk the seabed with a will that has no single throat to speak it
